fusions.name: First Glance
fusions.desc: Sends a strand down your line of sight that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your critical chance is 30% higher against an enemy that has not yet been hurt.

fusions.name: Field of Regard
fusions.desc: Ties everything in your field of view to your gaze, in a cone 5 tiles long. It deals 12 damage, stuns each target for 1 second and leaves it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Sightline
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far.

fusions.name: Knot for Every Look
fusions.desc: Every hit you land on an enemy ties a knot on it, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per knot (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a knot fades every 4 seconds.
